auth.auth_type_unknown.description: Error when a context's oauth.auth_type is not one of none, client_secret_post or private_key_jwt. AuthType is the value found.
auth.auth_type_unknown.other: unknown auth_type "{{.AuthType}}": use none, client_secret_post or private_key_jwt

auth.ca_no_certs.description: Error when the CA bundle in tls.ca_cert contains no PEM certificates. Where is the file path, or tls.ca_cert when the bundle was given inline.

auth.cache_write_failed.description: Error when a token was obtained but could not be saved to the token cache. Error is the underlying system error.
auth.cache_write_failed.other: signed in, but could not save the token: {{.Error}}

auth.callback_issuer_mismatch.description: Error when the sign-in redirect names a different issuer than the one configured, which means the response did not come from the expected authorization server. Issuer is the configured issuer.
auth.callback_issuer_mismatch.other: the sign-in response came from a different authorization server than {{.Issuer}}; sign-in stopped

auth.client_auth_required.description: Error when a grant that needs client authentication is configured with auth_type none. Grant is the grant type.
auth.client_auth_required.other: the {{.Grant}} grant needs auth_type client_secret_post or private_key_jwt

auth.discovery_failed.description: Error when the authorization server's metadata cannot be fetched. Issuer is the configured issuer, Error is the underlying error.
auth.discovery_failed.other: could not read the server metadata for {{.Issuer}}: {{.Error}}

auth.discovery_issuer_mismatch.description: Error when the issuer reported in the server metadata differs from the configured issuer. Configured and Reported are the two values.
auth.discovery_issuer_mismatch.other: the server reports issuer {{.Reported}}, but the context is configured with {{.Configured}}

auth.discovery_missing_endpoint.description: Error when the server metadata lacks an endpoint that the grant needs. Endpoint is the metadata field name.

auth.grant_unsupported.description: Error when a context's oauth.grant_type is not supported. Grant is the value found.
auth.grant_unsupported.other: grant type "{{.Grant}}" is not supported: use authorization_code or client_credentials

auth.key_missing_member.description: Error when the private key lacks a member the signer needs. Where is the file path, or oauth.private_jwk when the key was given inline. Member is kid or alg.

auth.key_not_jwk.description: Error when the private key is not a JSON Web Key. Where is the file path, or oauth.private_jwk when the key was given inline.
auth.key_not_jwk.other: {{.Where}} is not a valid JSON Web Key

auth.key_not_private.description: Error when the key is a public key or invalid instead of a private key. Where is the file path, or oauth.private_jwk when the key was given inline.
auth.key_not_private.other: {{.Where}} does not contain a valid private key

auth.listen_failed.description: Error when the local sign-in listener cannot bind its address, for example because the port is in use. Address is host:port, Error is the underlying system error.
auth.listen_failed.other: could not listen on {{.Address}} for the sign-in redirect: {{.Error}}; free the port or set a different oauth.redirect_uri

auth.login_required.description: Error when no token can be produced without the user signing in. Name is the context name.
auth.login_required.other: no valid token for context "{{.Name}}"; run 'ibm-agentid login' to sign in

auth.login_required_secret.description: Error when no token can be produced and the context uses a client secret that is not available. Name is the context name.
auth.login_required_secret.other: no valid token for context "{{.Name}}"; run 'ibm-agentid login' again, or set IBM_AGENTID_CLIENT_SECRET

auth.login_timeout.description: Error when the browser sign-in did not finish in time. Duration is how long the CLI waited.

auth.page_failure_body.description: Body text of the browser page shown when sign-in did not complete.
auth.page_failure_body.other: Sign-in did not complete. Return to the terminal for details.

auth.page_failure_title.description: Title of the browser page shown when sign-in did not complete.

auth.page_rejected_body.description: Body text of the browser page shown for a request to the local sign-in listener that was not the expected redirect.
auth.page_rejected_body.other: This request was not the expected sign-in redirect.

auth.page_rejected_title.description: Title of the browser page shown for a request to the local sign-in listener that was not the expected redirect.

auth.page_success_body.description: Body text of the browser page shown after a successful sign-in.
auth.page_success_body.other: You can close this window and return to the terminal.

auth.page_success_title.description: Title of the browser page shown after a successful sign-in.

auth.prompt_opening.description: Terminal message printed before the browser is opened for sign-in. The sign-in URL follows on the next line.
auth.prompt_opening.other: Opening your browser to sign in. If it does not open, visit this URL:

auth.prompt_visit.description: Terminal message printed when the browser is not opened automatically. The sign-in URL follows on the next line.
auth.prompt_visit.other: To sign in, visit this URL:

auth.prompt_waiting.description: Terminal message printed while waiting for the browser sign-in to finish.
auth.prompt_waiting.other: Waiting for sign-in to complete (press Ctrl+C to cancel)...

auth.redirect_invalid.description: Error when oauth.redirect_uri is not an http loopback URI (127.0.0.1, [::1] or localhost). URI is the value found.
auth.redirect_invalid.other: invalid redirect_uri "{{.URI}}": it must be an http URL on 127.0.0.1, [::1] or localhost

auth.secret_missing.description: Error when a client_secret_post context has no client secret to use. Name is the context name.
auth.secret_missing.other: context "{{.Name}}" needs a client secret: put client_secret in the login input, or set IBM_AGENTID_CLIENT_SECRET and leave it out

auth.setting_missing.description: Error when a required context setting is empty. Name is the context name, Setting is the setting path such as oauth.issuer.

config.home_dir_unresolved.description: The user's home directory could not be determined, so the CLI cannot locate its state directory (~/.ibm-agentid). Error is the underlying system error.
config.home_dir_unresolved.other: could not determine the home directory: {{.Error}}

context.col_name.description: Column heading in the context list: the context name.

context.col_server.description: Column heading in the context list: the server URL.

context.col_token.description: Column heading in the context list: the state of the cached token.

context.current_short.description: Short help text of the context current command.
context.current_short.other: Print the name of the active context

context.delete_aborted.description: Error when the user does not confirm deleting a context, or there is no input to confirm with.
context.delete_aborted.other: not deleted: confirmation is needed, so answer yes or use --yes

context.delete_confirm.description: Prompt before deleting a context, answered on standard input. Name is the context name. The text ends with a space because the answer follows on the same line.
context.delete_confirm.other: Delete the context "{{.Name}}" and its cached token? [y/N]

context.delete_short.description: Short help text of the context delete command.
context.delete_short.other: Delete a context and its cached token

context.deleted.description: Printed after a context is deleted. Name is the context name.

context.exists.description: Error when renaming a context to a name that is already registered. Name is the existing context name.

context.invalid_name.description: Error when a context name has characters or a length that is not allowed. Name is the rejected name.
context.invalid_name.other: invalid context name "{{.Name}}": use letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', start with a letter or digit, and keep it to 64 characters or fewer

context.list_empty.description: Printed by context list when no context is saved.
context.list_empty.other: No contexts are saved. Run "ibm-agentid login" to create one.

context.list_short.description: Short help text of the context list command.

context.long.description: Long help text of the context command. The subcommand names are literal and must not be translated.
context.long.other:
Manage the saved contexts. A context holds the server, TLS and OAuth settings of one deployment, and has its own cached token.

The active context is chosen, in order, by the --context flag, the IBM_AGENTID_CONTEXT environment variable, the current context, and then "default".

Subcommands: list, use, current, view, rename, delete.

context.nil_environment.description: Internal error when a context is saved without any environment settings. Name is the context name.

context.not_found.description: Error when a named context is not registered in config.yaml. Name is the context name.

context.rename_short.description: Short help text of the context rename command.
context.rename_short.other: Rename a context and move its cached token

context.renamed.description: Printed after a context is renamed. Old and New are the context names.

context.short.description: Short help text of the context command.

context.token_expired.description: Token state in the context list: the cached token has expired.

context.token_none.description: Token state in the context list: there is no cached token.

context.token_stale.description: Token state in the context list: the cached token was issued for different settings and is ignored.

context.token_valid.description: Token state in the context list: the cached token is usable.

context.use_short.description: Short help text of the context use command.
context.use_short.other: Make a context the current one

context.used.description: Printed after the current context is changed. Name is the context name.

context.view_short.description: Short help text of the context view command.
context.view_short.other: Show the settings of a context

context.yes_flag.description: Help text of the context delete --yes flag.

data.data_flag.description: Help text of the -d/--data flag, shared by every command that takes data.
data.data_flag.other: Path to the data file, or - for stdin. YAML or JSON.

data.output_flag.description: Help text of the -o/--output flag, which sets the format of --template.

data.template_flag.description: Help text of the --template flag, shared by every command that takes data.
data.template_flag.other: Print a skeleton of the data and exit.

input.empty.description: Error when the -d data is empty or only whitespace.

input.invalid_data.description: Error when the -d data cannot be decoded: bad syntax or a value of the wrong type. The text avoids quoting the data because it can hold secrets.
input.invalid_data.other: the input is not valid YAML or JSON, or a value has the wrong type (a value that starts with @ must be quoted)

input.invalid_server.description: Error when the server property is not an http or https URL with a host, or contains a user name or password.
input.invalid_server.other: "server" must be an http or https URL with a host and no user name or password

input.required.description: Error when a required property is missing or empty. Property is the dotted property name.

input.terminal_stdin.description: Error when -d - is used and standard input is a terminal.
input.terminal_stdin.other: -d - reads standard input, but it is a terminal; pipe the data in or use a heredoc

input.too_large.description: Error when the -d data is larger than the limit. Max is the limit in bytes.
input.too_large.other: the input is larger than {{.Max}} bytes

input.unknown_format.description: Error when --template is given an output format other than yaml or json. Format is what was supplied.
input.unknown_format.other: unknown template format "{{.Format}}"; use yaml or json

logging.invalid_setting.description: Warning shown when a logging setting has an unrecognized value and the default is used instead. Setting is the environment variable name, Value is what was supplied, Default is the value used.
logging.invalid_setting.other: invalid value "{{.Value}}" for {{.Setting}}; using the default "{{.Default}}"

logging.open_failed.description: Warning shown when the user asked for logging but the log file cannot be opened. Path is the log file, Error is the underlying system error.
logging.open_failed.other: could not open the log file {{.Path}}: {{.Error}}; continuing without logging

login.data_required.description: Error when login is run without -d and without --template.
login.data_required.other: login needs the connection data: use -d <file> (or -d - for stdin), or --template to print a skeleton

login.inline_secret.description: Warning when a secret is given inline and is saved to config.yaml as written. Property is the dotted property name.
login.inline_secret.other: warning: {{.Property}} is saved to config.yaml as written; use @file to keep it out

login.long.description: Long help text of the login command. Property names, flag names and the @ prefix are literal and must not be translated.
login.long.other:
Sign in to an IBM Agent Identity server, save the connection as a named context and cache the token.

The connection is described by YAML or JSON data, read with -d from a file or from stdin (-). Use --template to print a skeleton.

Data properties (* is required):
  context                   Name to save the context under. The --context flag wins.
  server *                  Base URL of the server.
  tls.ca_cert               CA bundle: @file or inline PEM.
  tls.insecure_skip_verify  Skip TLS verification. For local development only.
  oauth.issuer *            OIDC issuer URL.
  oauth.client_id *         OAuth client ID.
  oauth.grant_type          authorization_code (default) or client_credentials.
  oauth.auth_type           none (default), private_key_jwt or client_secret_post.
  oauth.private_jwk         Private JWK for private_key_jwt: @file or inline JSON.
  oauth.client_secret       Client secret: @file or inline value.
  oauth.redirect_uri        Fixed loopback redirect URI.
  oauth.scopes              List of scopes to request.

A value that starts with @ names a file. In YAML, quote it. A relative path is relative to the data file. An inline secret is saved as written, so prefer @file.

If the sign-in fails, nothing is saved.

login.no_browser_flag.description: Help text of the login --no-browser flag.
login.no_browser_flag.other: Print the sign-in URL and do not open a browser.

login.no_save_flag.description: Help text of the login --no-save flag.
login.no_save_flag.other: Sign in without saving the context or the token.

login.print_token_flag.description: Help text of the login --print-token flag.
login.print_token_flag.other: Print the access token on stdout.

login.short.other: Sign in to an IBM Agent Identity server and save the context

login.success.description: Printed after a successful login that saved the context. Name is the context name.
login.success.other: Signed in. The context "{{.Name}}" is saved and current.

login.success_no_save.description: Printed after a successful login with --no-save.

login.timeout_flag.description: Help text of the login --timeout flag.
login.timeout_flag.other: How long to wait for the browser sign-in (default 5m).

root.context_flag.description: Help text of the global --context flag.
root.context_flag.other: Name of the context to use or create.

root.short.description: Short help text of the root command.
root.short.other: Command-line client for IBM Agent Identity

source.empty_path.description: Error when a value is a file reference with no path, that is, only the @ prefix.
source.empty_path.other: a file reference needs a path after the @

source.not_regular.description: Error when a file reference names something that is not a regular file, such as a directory. Path is the absolute path.

source.unreadable.description: Error when a file reference names a file that does not exist or cannot be read. Path is the absolute path, Error is the underlying system error.
